events.title_en: Exhibition by Çağrı Saray titled "Diminishing Time."
events.title_el: Έκθεση του Çağrı Saray με τίτλο "Φθίνων Χρόνος".
events.description_tr:
Azalan Zaman, Çağrı Saray'ın kimlik, kişisel hafıza, ev-mekan kavramı ve kentsel çevrenin toplumsal-politik anlamlarına dair sorgulamalara dayanan enstalasyonları, çizimleri, gravürleri, fotoğraf ve videolarından oluşuyor.

Sanatçının 1999-2015 yılları arasında ürettiği ve bu sergide bir araya getirdiği bir dizi çalışma, bugüne ve geçmişe ait verileri, doğrudan ve aykırı unsurlar yerine, sistematik ve her şeyi doğrulayan tek bir form olarak ortaya çıkarmayı amaçlıyor. Çağrı Saray, her yeni deneyim ve olayla birlikte toplumsal koşullar bağlamında yeniden inşa ettiği hafızasının arka planında geçmişini yeniden gözden geçiriyor. Yerel ve küresel yaşam koşullarını sarsan, zorlayıcı olan politik, ekonomik, toplumsal değişimlere ve bu değişimlerin hafızayı nasıl dönüştürdüğüne veya azalttığına odaklanıyor.

Sanatçının çalışmalarındaki içerik ve formlar, bu karşıt koşulların çeşitli özelliklerini, süreçlerini ve anlarını titizlikle haritalandırıyor. Saray, egemen söylemin ürettiği görsel kültürün egemen gücüne karşı yalın ama çekici ve muhalif bir kavram tercihi sunuyor.

Saray'ın devamı olarak 2004, 2009 ve 2011 yıllarında yarattığı 'Kırmızı Oda', 'Bekleme Odası' ve 'Kayıp Oda' adlı seriler ilk kez bir arada sergide görülebilecek.

“4/12: Bir Evin Topografyası” projesi kapsamında bir yürüyüşçünün bir dizi adımını gösteren “Denizden Eve: 282 Adım” ve “Okulu Ölçmek” başlıklı çizimler özünde zaman kavramına odaklanıyor. Çocukluk ve yetişkinlik arasındaki karşılaştırmalar, Saray'ın Peter Handke'nin "Çocukluk Şarkısı" adlı eserini el yazısıyla görselleştirdiği videosunda izleyicilerin karşısına çıkıyor. Saray, “Ticari Olmayan Otobiyografi” ile bir sanatçı olarak sanat eseri yaratmanın dışında üretmek ve yönetmek zorunda kaldığı faaliyetleri ve fırsatları İstanbul sanat ortamının ekonomik ve sistematik verileri bağlamında belgeliyor. 5 farklı odadan oluşan “Kırmızı Oda” (2004), “Bekleme Odası v1” (2009), “Kayıp Oda” (2011), “Kırmızı Oda: Sekanslar” (2005) ve “Işıksız Oda” (2007) serilerinden oluşan “3 Hikaye – 3 Anlatı” serisi bu özgeçmiş envanterinin doruk noktasını oluşturuyor.
 “Hafıza Mekanları” resim serisi, küreselleşmenin arkasında yatan kentsel dönüşüm olgusunu ve tüketim ideolojilerinin hakimiyetini mimari doku içinde sunarken, “Hissediyorum…” ve “Rezonans” başlıklı video çalışmaları, modern zaman koşullarında bireyin doğa (ekoloji) ve şehir (şehircilik) ile ilişkisine dair güç, direnç, haz, umut ve güçsüzlük, bağlılık, umutsuzluk gibi görsel metaforlar yaratıyor.

Çağrı Saray’ın eserlerine buradan ulaşabilirsiniz: cagrisaray.blogspot.com.tr

Çağrı Saray
 1979 İstanbul'da doğdu. İstanbul'da yaşıyor ve çalışıyor. 2001 yılında Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi'nden mezun oldu. Saray, 2002-2004 yılları arasında Bahçeşehir Üniversitesi İletişim Fakültesi, Görsel Sanatlar ve Görsel İletişim Tasarımı Bölümü'nde araştırma görevlisi olarak görev yaptı. Yüksek Lisans ve Sanatta Yeterlilik diplomasını Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi'nden aldı. Saray, akademik kariyerine Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi Temel Tasarım Bölümü'nde Yardımcı Doçent olarak devam ediyor.

Saray, 2001 yılından bu yana “Gri Koridor” (2013, Paris, Fransa), “4/12: Bir Evin Topografyası” (2011, İstanbul, Türkiye) ve “Hafıza Kutuları-1” (2001, İstanbul, Türkiye) dahil olmak üzere 9 kişisel sergi gerçekleştirdi.

Çağrı Saray'ın çalışmaları, “Kırılmalar ve Yakınsama” (2014, Kuad Galeri, İstanbul), “3. Uluslararası Çanakkale Bienali” (2012, Çanakkale, Türkiye) ve “Ateşin Çarptığı Yer” (2011, İstanbul, Türkiye) başta olmak üzere 80'in üzerinde yerli ve yabancı karma sergide yer aldı.
events.description_en:
Diminishing Time consists of Çağrı Saray’s installations, drawings, etchings, photographs and videos based upon questionings of identity, personal memory, the concept of home-space and the societal-political meanings of urban environment.

A series of works that the artist produced between 1999-2015 and assembled in this exhibition aims to expose the data from today and from the past as a single form that is systematic and all-affirming instead of direct and anomalistic elements. Çağrı Saray reviews his past in the back of his memory which he reconstructs with every new experience and incident in the context of social circumstances. He focuses on the political, economical, social changes that are compelling and that unsettles local and global life conditions, and how these changes transform or diminish the memory.

The content and forms within the artist’s works meticulously map various features, processes and moments of these opposable conditions. Saray offers a bare, yet appealing and oppositional choice of notion against the dominant power of the visual culture produced by sovereign discourse.

The series called “The Red Room”, “The Waiting Room” and “The Lost Room” Saray created in 2004, 2009 and 2011 as a follow-up can be seen altogether for the first time in the exhibition.

Part of the project “4/12: Topography of a Home” and showing a series of steps of a walker, the drawings titled “From the Sea to Home: 282 Steps” and “Measuring the School”, in essence, focus on the concept of time. Comparisons between childhood and adulthood confronts the audience as Saray’s visualization of Peter Handke’s “Song of Childhood” by handwriting in his video. With “Non-Commercial Autobiography”, Saray documents in the context of the economical and systematic data of the Istanbul art scene the activities and opportunities he had to produce and manage other than creating artworks as an artist. Located in 5 different rooms, series called “3 Stories – 3 Narratives” that includes “The Red Room” (2004), “Waiting Room v1” (2009), “The Lost Room” (2011), “The Red Room: Sequences” (2005) and “The Lightless Room” (2007) sets the climax to this résumé inventory.
 While the painting series “Memory Spaces” presents the phenomena of urban transformation that lies behind globalization and the dominance of consumerism ideologies within the architectural texture, video works titled “Feeling like…” and “Resonance” create visual metaphores of power, resistance, pleasure, hope and powerlessness, abidance, hopelessness as to the individual’s relationship with nature (ecology) and city (urbanism) in modern-time conditions.

You can find Çağrı Saray’s works here: cagrisaray.blogspot.com.tr

Çağrı Saray
 Born 1979, Istanbul. Lives and works in Istanbul. Graduated from Marmara University Faculty of Fine Arts in 2001. Saray took charge as a research assistant in Bahçeşehir University’s Faculty of Communication, Visual Arts and Visual Communication Design Department between 2002-2004. He received his MFA and Proficiency in Art degree from Marmara University Faculty of Fine Arts. Saray continues his academic career as Assistant Professor at Marmara University Faculty of Fine Arts, Basic Design Department.

Since 2001, Saray executed 9 solo shows including “Grey Corridor” (2013, Paris, France), “4/12: Topography of a Home” (2011, Istanbul, Turkey) and “Memory Boxes-1” (2001, Istanbul, Turkey).

Çağrı Saray’s works were exhibited in over 80 domestic and foreign group shows including “Ruptures and Convergences” (2014, Kuad Gallery, Istanbul), “3. International Çanakkale Biennial” (2012, Çanakkale, Turkey) and “Where Fire Has Struck” (2011, Istanbul, Turkey).
events.description_el:
Το Diminishing Time αποτελείται από εγκαταστάσεις, σχέδια, χαρακτικά, φωτογραφίες και βίντεο του Çağrı Saray που βασίζονται σε αμφισβητήσεις της ταυτότητας, της προσωπικής μνήμης, της έννοιας του σπιτιού-χώρου και των κοινωνικοπολιτικών σημασιών του αστικού περιβάλλοντος.

Μια σειρά έργων που παρήγαγε ο καλλιτέχνης μεταξύ 1999-2015 και συγκέντρωσε σε αυτή την έκθεση, στοχεύει να εκθέσει τα δεδομένα από το σήμερα και το παρελθόν ως μια ενιαία μορφή συστηματική και καταφατική αντί για άμεσα και ανωμαλιστικά στοιχεία. Ο Çağrı Saray κάνει μια αναδρομή στο παρελθόν του στο πίσω μέρος της μνήμης του, το οποίο ανασυνθέτει με κάθε νέα εμπειρία και περιστατικό στο πλαίσιο των κοινωνικών συνθηκών. Εστιάζει στις πολιτικές, οικονομικές, κοινωνικές αλλαγές που είναι επιτακτικές και που διαταράσσουν τις τοπικές και παγκόσμιες συνθήκες ζωής και πώς αυτές οι αλλαγές μεταμορφώνουν ή μειώνουν τη μνήμη.

Το περιεχόμενο και οι μορφές στα έργα του καλλιτέχνη χαρτογραφούν σχολαστικά διάφορα χαρακτηριστικά, διαδικασίες και στιγμές αυτών των αντίθετων συνθηκών. Ο Saray προσφέρει μια γυμνή, αλλά ελκυστική και αντιθετική επιλογή της έννοιας ενάντια στην κυρίαρχη δύναμη της οπτικής κουλτούρας που παράγεται από τον κυρίαρχο λόγο.

Οι σειρές με τίτλο "The Red Room", "The Waiting Room" και "The Lost Room" Saray που δημιουργήθηκαν το 2004, το 2009 και το 2011 ως συνέχεια μπορούν να προβληθούν συνολικά για πρώτη φορά στην έκθεση.

Μέρος του έργου «4/12: Τοπογραφία ενός σπιτιού» και δείχνει μια σειρά από βήματα ενός περιπατητή, τα σχέδια με τίτλο «From the Sea to Home: 282 Steps» και «Measuring the School», ουσιαστικά, εστιάζουν στην έννοια του χρόνου. Οι συγκρίσεις μεταξύ της παιδικής ηλικίας και της ενηλικίωσης αντιμετωπίζουν το κοινό ως την οπτικοποίηση του «Song of Childhood» του Peter Handke από τον Saray με χειρόγραφο στο βίντεό του. Με τη «Μη Εμπορική Αυτοβιογραφία», ο Saray τεκμηριώνει στο πλαίσιο των οικονομικών και συστηματικών δεδομένων της καλλιτεχνικής σκηνής της Κωνσταντινούπολης τις δραστηριότητες και τις ευκαιρίες που είχε να παράγει και να διαχειριστεί εκτός από τη δημιουργία έργων τέχνης ως καλλιτέχνης. Βρίσκεται σε 5 διαφορετικά δωμάτια, οι σειρές με τίτλο "3 Ιστορίες - 3 Αφηγήσεις" που περιλαμβάνει "The Red Room" (2004), "Waiting Room v1" (2009), "The Lost Room" (2011), "The Red Room: Sequences" (2005) και "The Lightless Room" (2007) θέτει το climé.
 Ενώ η σειρά ζωγραφικής «Memory Spaces» παρουσιάζει τα φαινόμενα αστικής μεταμόρφωσης που κρύβεται πίσω από την παγκοσμιοποίηση και την κυριαρχία των ιδεολογιών καταναλωτισμού στην αρχιτεκτονική υφή, τα έργα βίντεο με τίτλους «Feeling like…» και «Resonance» δημιουργούν οπτικές μεταφορές δύναμης, αντίστασης, ευχαρίστησης, ελπίδας και αδυναμίας, παραμονής, απελπισίας και σχέσης με την πόλη. συνθήκες της σύγχρονης εποχής.

Μπορείτε να βρείτε τα έργα του Çağrı Saray εδώ: cagrisaray.blogspot.com.tr

Çağrı Saray
 Γεννήθηκε το 1979 στην Κωνσταντινούπολη. Ζει και εργάζεται στην Κωνσταντινούπολη. Αποφοίτησε από τη Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών του Πανεπιστημίου του Μαρμαρά το 2001. Ο Saray ανέλαβε ως βοηθός ερευνητής στο Τμήμα Επικοινωνίας, Εικαστικών Τεχνών και Σχεδιασμού Εικαστικών Επικοινωνιών του Πανεπιστημίου Bahçeşehir μεταξύ 2002-2004. Έλαβε το πτυχίο MFA και Proficiency in Art από τη Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών του Πανεπιστημίου του Μαρμαρά. Ο Saray συνεχίζει την ακαδημαϊκή του σταδιοδρομία ως Επίκουρος Καθηγητής στη Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών του Πανεπιστημίου Marmara, Τμήμα Βασικού Σχεδιασμού.

Από το 2001, ο Saray εκτέλεσε 9 σόλο παραστάσεις, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των «Grey Corridor» (2013, Παρίσι, Γαλλία), «4/12: Topography of a Home» (2011, Istanbul, Τουρκία) και «Memory Boxes-1» (2001, Istanbul, Τουρκία).

Τα έργα του Çağrı Saray εκτέθηκαν σε περισσότερες από 80 εγχώριες και ξένες ομαδικές εκθέσεις, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των "Ruptures and Convergences" (2014, Kuad Gallery, Istanbul), "3. International Çanakkale Biennial" (2012, Çanakkale, Τουρκία) και "Where Fire Has Struck" (2011, Istanbul, Turkey).

events.description_tr: 212 Photography Istanbul festivali kapsamında Galata Rum Okulu’nun sergi salonlarında düzenlenen seçkide, Ebru Yıldız’ın müzik ve sahne dünyasını belgeleyen çarpıcı fotoğraf çalışmaları sanatseverlerle buluştu.
events.description_en: Hosted across the exhibition halls of the Galata Greek School during the 212 Photography Istanbul festival, this showcase presented striking photographic works by Ebru Yıldız.
events.description_el: Στην επιλογή που πραγματοποιήθηκε στους εκθεσιακούς χώρους του Ελληνικού Σχολείου Γαλατά στο πλαίσιο του φεστιβάλ Φωτογραφίας 212 Κωνσταντινούπολης, παρουσιάστηκαν στους λάτρεις της τέχνης εντυπωσιακά φωτογραφικά έργα της Ebru Yıldız που καταγράφουν τον κόσμο της μουσικής και της σκηνής.

events.title_tr: Caudalie Özel Lansmanı Galata Rum Okulu'nda!
events.title_en: Caudalie Special Launch at the Galata Greek School
events.title_el: Ιδιωτική Παρουσίαση της Caudalie στο Ελληνικό Σχολείο Γαλατά
events.description_tr: 29 Ocak 2025’te Caudalie, yeni serisinin lansmanını Galata Rum Okulu’nun büyüleyici atmosferinde gerçekleştirdi. Bu eşsiz etkinlikte katılımcılar, sanat ve tarihle iç içe geçmiş bir mekânda yeni koleksiyonu keşfetme fırsatı buldu. İlham veren bir geceye ev sahipliği yaptığımız için mutluyuz.
events.description_en: On January 29, 2025, Caudalie hosted the exclusive launch of its new collection within the enchanting historic atmosphere of the Galata Greek School. During this unique event, guests had the opportunity to discover the new line in a setting where art and history intertwine. We are delighted to have hosted such an inspiring evening.
events.description_el: Στις 29 Ιανουαρίου 2025, η Caudalie πραγματοποίησε την επίσημη παρουσίαση της νέας της σειράς στη μαγευτική ιστορική ατμόσφαιρα της Ελληνικής Σχολής Γαλατά. Σε αυτή τη μοναδική εκδήλωση, οι προσκεκλημένοι είχαν την ευκαιρία να ανακαλύψουν τη νέα συλλογή σε έναν χώρο όπου η τέχνη συναντά την ιστορία. Είμαστε ιδιαίτερα χαρούμενοι που φιλοξενήσαμε μια τόσο εμπνευσμένη βραδιά.

events.title_tr: Violete Ikari konseri: "Galata'da ince bir yağmur..." Neapoleos & Stavropoleos Kutsal Metropolitliği Kadın Korosu ile.
events.title_en: Concert with Violeta Ikari: "Fine rain in Galata..." with the Women's Choir of the Holy Metropolis of Neapoli and Stavroupoli.
events.title_el: Συναυλία με τη Βιολέτα Ίκαρη: "Στο Γαλατά ψιλή βροχή..." και τη Γυναικεία Χορωδία της Ιεράς Μητροπόλεως Νεαπόλεως και Σταυρουπόλεως.
events.description_tr: Yunan müziğinin sevilen sesi Violete Ikari, Neapoleos & Stavropoleos Kutsal Metropolitliği Kadın Korosu eşliğinde “Galata’da İnce Bir Yağmur…” başlıklı özel konserde Galata Rum Okulu sahnesinde dinleyicilerle buluştu.
events.description_en: Acclaimed Greek vocalist Violete Ikari, accompanied by the Women’s Choir of the Holy Metropolis of Neapoli and Stavroupoli, performed the special concert “A Fine Rain in Galata…” at the Galata Greek School.
events.description_el: Η καταξιωμένη ερμηνεύτρια Βιολέτα Ίκαρη, συνοδευόμενη από τη Γυναικεία Χορωδία της Ιεράς Μητροπόλεως Νεαπόλεως και Σταυρουπόλεως, παρουσίασε μια ξεχωριστή συναυλία στη Σχολή Γαλατά.

events.description_tr:
212 Photography İstanbul her yıl düzenlenen uluslararası bir festivaldir.

Kültürel ve eğitimsel bağlamda sergiler, atölye çalışmaları, konferanslar, film gösterimleri ve çok daha fazlasını içeren bir program düzenlemektedir. Aynı zamanda bir dizi çevrimiçi eylem de düzenliyor.

Her yıl yenilenen ve yeni bir referans noktası etrafında düzenlenen zengin program, izleyiciye fotoğraf sanatı alanında yeni isimler, yeni kişilikler, yeni akımlar ve yaklaşımlarla tanışma fırsatı sunarak, fotoğraf sanatının çağdaş dilinin diğer sanatlarla denemelerini sunuyor. Festivalin amacı, çeşitli etkinlikler için yeni, tarihi ve atmosferik mekan ve mekanlardan yararlanarak yeni ufuklar açmaktır. İzleyiciyi şehrin kültürel mirasını tanımaya ve deneyimlemeye davet ederek, fotoğraf sanatı aracılığıyla mekan ve manzara hafızasını genişletmeyi amaçlıyor.

6 yıldır toplam 30 mekânda 150.000'den fazla seyircinin ziyaret ettiği 212 Fotoğraf İstanbul Festivali, özellikle zengin ve yenilikçi bir programla ziyaretçilerini ağırlamaya hazırlanıyor.
events.description_en:
212 Photography Istanbul is an international festival held every year.

It organizes a program that includes exhibitions, workshops, lectures, film screenings and much more in a cultural and educational context. At the same time, it organizes a series of online actions.

The rich program, which is renewed every year and organized around a new point of reference, offers the viewer the opportunity to meet new names, new personalities, new trends and approaches in the field of the art of photography, presenting the experimentation of the contemporary language of the art of photography with other arts. The aim of the festival is to open new horizons by utilizing new, historical and atmospheric spaces and places for its various events. By inviting the viewer to get to know and experiment with the city's cultural heritage, it aims to expand the memory of space and landscape through the art of photography.

The 212 Photography Istanbul Festival, which for 6 years has been visited by more than 150,000 spectators in a total of 30 locations, is preparing to welcome its visitors with a particularly rich and innovative program.
events.description_el:
212 Photography Istanbul είναι ένα διεθνές φεστιβάλ που πραγματοποιείται κάθε χρόνο.

Διοργανώνει ένα πρόγραμμαπου περιλαμβάνει εκθέσεις, εργαστήρια, ομιλίες, προβολές ταινιών και πολλά ακόμη σε ένα πλαίσιο πολιτιστικό και εκπαιδευτικό. Παράλληλα διοργανώνει μια σειρά από διαδικτυακές δράσεις.

Το πλούσιο πρόγραμμα, το οποίο κάθε χρόνο ανανεώνεται και οργανώνεται γύρω από ένα νέα σημείο αναφοράς προσφέρει στον θεατή την ευκαιρία να γνωρίσει νέα ονόματα, νέες προσωπικότητες, νέες τάσεις και προσεγγίσεις στον χώρος της τέχνης της φωτογραφίας παρουσιάζοντας τους πειραματισμούς της σύγχρονης γλώσσας της τέχνης της φωτογραφίες με άλλες τέχνες. Στόχος του φεστιβάλ είναι να ανοίξει νέους ορίζοντες αξιοποιώντας νέους, ιστορικούς και ατμοσφαιρικούς χώρους και τόπους για τις ποικίλες εκδηλώσεις του. Προσκαλώντας τον θεατή να γνωρίσει και να πειραματιστεί με την πολιτιστική κληρονομιά της πόλης του αποσκοπεί στη διεύρυνση της μνήμης του χώρου και του τοπίου μέσα από την τέχνη της φωτογραφίας.

Το Φεστιβάλ 212 Photography Istanbul, το οποίο εδώ και 6 χρόνια επισκέφθηκαν περισσότεροι από 150.000 θεατές σε συνολικά 30 τόπους, ετοιμάζεται να υποδεχτεί τους επισκέπτες του με ένα ιδιαιτέρως πλούσιο και πρωτοποριακό πρόγραμμα.

events.description_tr:
Üç Ayaklı Kedi’nin izini süren bienal

18. İstanbul Bienali, bu yıl alışılmış bienal formatlarının ötesine geçerek, üç yıla yayılan özgün yapısıyla sanatseverlerle buluşuyor. Küratör Christine Tohmé tarafından Üç Ayaklı Kedi başlığıyla kurgulanan bienalin ilk ayağı, 20 Eylül – 23 Kasım 2025 tarihleri arasında, İstanbul’un Beyoğlu Karaköy hattında yer alan sekiz farklı mekânda bienal sponsoru Koç Holding’in katkılarıyla ücretsiz olarak ziyaret edilebilecek.

Bienalin ilk ayağına davet edilen 47 sanatçı; atölye ziyaretleri ile sanatçı buluşmalarının yapıldığı ve 31 Ekim–15 Aralık 2024 tarihleri arasındaki açık çağrıya gelen dosyaların değerlendirildiği kapsamlı bir araştırma sürecinin sonucunda belirlendi.

Açık çağrı süreci, 18. İstanbul Bienali’nin küratoryal araştırma sürecinin en önemli adımlarından biri oldu. Küratör Christine Tohmé üç ay boyunca 105 ülkeden yaklaşık 1.500 sanatçının başvurusunu inceledi ve ardından serginin kavramsal çerçevesiyle örtüştüğünü düşündüğü isimlerle görüşmeler yaptı.

Bienalin ikinci ayağı 2026 yılında İstanbul Bienali Akademisi’nin kurulması ve sanat inisiyatiflerinin katılımıyla düzenlenecek kamusal programlarla devam edecek. Bienal 2027’deki üçüncü ve son ayağı kapsamında gerçekleştirilecek atölyeler, performanslar ve nihai bir sergiyle tamamlanacak.

Galata Rum Okulu olarak, 18. İstanbul Bienali’ne ev sahipliği yapmaktan büyük mutluluk duyuyoruz.

Bienal küratörü Christine Tohmé, bienal için kaleme aldığı kavramsal çerçeve yazısında üç ayakta tamamlanacak bu bienali bir kediye benzettiğini belirtiyor ve şöyle ekliyordu: “Giderek hızlanan yıkım, zorunlu göçler ve önü alınamayan krizler tüm ufukları ve gelecek olasılıklarını paramparça ediyor. Sürekli daralan bir şimdiyle karşı karşıya kalan bedenlerimiz, pek çok saate ayak uydurmaya zorlanıyor: kimisi hızlı kimisi yavaş kimisi bozuk. Bir sendeleyip bir ileri atıldığımız ikili bir devinim içine hapsolmuş, dengede durabileceğimiz adımı atmaya çabalıyoruz. Tıpkı kedi gibi biz de kendi etrafımızda dönüyor, kıvrılıyor, kaybolup yeniden ortaya çıkıyoruz. Yönümüzü bulmaya çalışırken, dinlenmeyi öğreniyor, bir yandan da korunmaya ve onarılmaya muhtaç parçalarımıza sahip çıkıyoruz.”

Tohmé, sanatçılara yaptığı açık çağrıda da bienalin odaklanacağı temaların çerçevesini aşağıdaki sorularla çizmişti:

Kırılganlık ve tekrar eden krizlerle karşı karşıya kaldığımızda, maddi koşullar ve güvensizlik hissi günlük hayatımızı nasıl etkiliyor? Kendimizle, bedenlerimizle ve toplumla olan ilişkimiz nasıl şekilleniyor? Soluklanabileceğimiz alanları nasıl yaratıyoruz? Alışılmadık dayanışma biçimlerini ve direniş için karşı-stratejileri nasıl keşfediyoruz? Onarmanın ve ileriye yönelik hayal kurmanın kol kola ilerlediği bir hareket, nasıl gelecekler tasavvur etmemize olanak tanıyor? Dünyalarımız aynı anda hem kâbuslara hem düşlere; hem geçiciliğe hem dayanıklılığa yer açacak şekilde çözülürken, bu dünyalarda yaşamaya nasıl devam edebiliriz?

Ayman Zedani, Çöl Denizleri Arasında (2021)

Naomi Ricon-Gallardo, Bir Mağara Üçlemesi serisine ait Opossumun Direnci (2019)

İpek Duben, Cenettin Çocukları II, III, IV (2000-2005)
events.description_en:
Tracing the Footsteps of the Three-Legged Cat: The 18th Istanbul Biennial

The 18th Istanbul Biennial, curated by Christine Tohmé, departs from conventional biennial models with a distinctive structure spanning three years. Titled The Three-Legged Cat, the biennial will unfold in three phases between 2025 and 2027.

The first phase will take place from 20 September to 23 November 2025 across eight venues in Istanbul’s Beyoğlu–Karaköy district. With the support of main sponsor Koç Holding, entry will be free of charge. Forty-seven participating artists were selected following an extensive research process that included studio visits, artist meetings, and the evaluation of submissions to an open call held between 31 October and 15 December 2024. During this process, over 1,500 applications from 105 countries were reviewed, forming one of the most significant steps in the curatorial framework of the biennial.

The biennial’s second phase will continue in 2026 with the establishment of the Istanbul Biennial Academy and a series of public programs developed in collaboration with art initiatives. The third and final phase in 2027 will bring the biennial to completion through workshops, performances, and a concluding exhibition.

As a host venue, Galata Greek School is proud to welcome the 18th Istanbul Biennial.

In her conceptual framework for the biennial, Christine Tohmé describes the project as a three-legged cat:

“Accelerating destruction, forced migrations, and unstoppable crises shatter horizons and fracture future possibilities. Confronted with an ever-shrinking present, our bodies are forced to keep pace with multiple times: some fast, some slow, some broken. Like a cat, we stumble and leap forward, turn around ourselves, curl up, vanish, and reappear. As we try to find our bearings, we learn to rest, while also protecting and repairing the fragile parts of ourselves.”
 In her call to artists, Tohmé further defined the biennial’s focus through key questions:

How do material conditions and insecurity affect our daily lives in times of fragility and recurring crises?
 How are our relationships with ourselves, our bodies, and society being reshaped?
 How do we create spaces of pause and breathing?
 How do we discover unconventional forms of solidarity and counter-strategies of resistance?
 How does the act of repair intertwine with imagining futures to open up new possibilities?
 As our worlds simultaneously unravel into nightmares and dreams, transience and resilience, how can we continue to live within them?
 The 18th Istanbul Biennial invites audiences to reflect on these questions while tracing the resilient, adaptive, and transformative path of the Three-Legged Cat.

Ayman Zedani, Between Desert Seas (2021)

Naomi Rincón-Gallardo, The Opossum’s Resistance (2019), from the series A Cave Trilogy

İpek Duben, Children of Paradise II, III, IV (2000–2005)

Say Maşallah Koleksiyonu, Esra Gülmen’in özgün sanatsal bakış açısını yansıtarak, farklı kültürlerin ortak sembollerine odaklanıyor. Sanatçının, modern yaşamın telaşı içinde unuttuğumuz değerlere dikkat çektiği bu koleksiyon, zarif detayları ve derin anlamlarıyla konuklarımızın büyük beğenisini topladı.

The Mesmerizing Union of Art and Jewelry! ✨

On December 18, we proudly hosted the launch of the ‘Esra Gülmen X Atasay’ #SayMaşallah capsule collection at the historic and enchanting atmosphere of Galata Greek School. 🎉

Η Μαγευτική Συνάντηση Τέχνης και Κοσμήματος!

events.description_tr:
C24 Gallery’nin düzenlediği, sanatçı İrfan Önürmen’nin “Bilinmeyen Neden” başlıklı kişisel sergisi 3 Kasım
 – 2 Aralık 2024 tarihleri arasında Galata Rum Okulu’nda sanatseverlerle buluşuyor.

İrfan Önürmen’in “Bilinmeyen Neden” adlı sergisinde sanatçının özgün stili niteliğindeki tül işlerinden
 kağıt kolajlara, beton çalışmalarından tuvallerine kadar farklı teknik ve yaklaşımları görebiliriz. Bu bilindik
 tekniklerinin yanı sıra sanatçı, zengin dağarcığına yeni bir malzeme ekleyerek zımpara kağıdına yaptığı
 boya ve sürtmelerle oluşturduğu işlerini sunar. Sanatçı, malzemeye ilgi duyar ve bu ilgi onu besler. Üretim
 serüveninin içinde kendine yeni alanlar açmak için denemeler yapmaktan çekinmez ve bu anlamda
 serüvenini oyunlaştırır. Yaşadığı bu çatallanmalar ve farklı yollardan yürüme isteği onda, bir yandan da
 biçim dilinin zenginleşmesi anlamına gelir. Sanatçı tuval resmiyle bağını hiç koparmamış ve dönüp dolaştığı
 yer hep boya resmi olmuştur. İrfan Önürmen’in tül yapıtlarında oluşturduğu şeffaflık, üç boyutluluk ve
 derinlik etkileri boya işlerinde de görülür. Zaman zaman soyut resmin sınırlarında da dolaşan bir resimsel
 dil geliştiren sanatçının işlerinde figür hiçbir zaman kaybolmaz. İnsan, silikleşir parçalanır ve belirsizleşir
 ama her zaman resminin ortasında büyük bir sorunsal gibi kendini belli eder. Burada insan sloganlaşmayan
 ama politik bir imgedir.

“Bilinmeyen Neden” adlı sergisi sanatçının kendi geçmişinin birikimi ve kalıntıları ile ilgilidir; bununla da
 felsefi bir sorgulama alanı yaratmak istemiştir. Sanatçı bu varoluşsal alanla biçimlenen belirsizlikler,
 çözülemeyen veya tam anlamıyla kavranamayan anlamlar üzerine düşünür ve üretir. Serginin kurgusunu
 ve üretimlerini bilinmezlik ile anlamın muğlaklığı üzerine temellendirmiştir. Sanatçı form, dil ve temsili
 içerik açısından çeşitlilik gösteren tüm çalışmalarında biçimsel göndermelerden öte izleyicide yarattığı
 etkiyi önemser. Giderek izleyiciyi kendi bilinmeyenlerine ve sorgulamalarına yönelterek içsel yolculuğunu
 fark etmeye teşvik eder. Önürmen hangi kavram veya malzemeyle çalışırsa çalışsın kendi dünyasındaki
 gerçeklik ve hayal gücü, görünen ve görünmeyenlerle tüm biçimsel kategorileri bulanıklaştırır. Sergisinde
 eski ve yeni ürettiği işlerini kronolojik bir sıra olmaksızın yan yana ve ard arda kurgulayarak yeni patikaların
 oluşmasını da deneyimler. Bu sergide farklı yaklaşımlarının, üretimlerinin arasındaki ilişkileri vurgulamak,
 biçimsel ve içeriğe dair sorunsalları ortaya çıkarmak istemiş, kendi içinde tartışmayı amaçlamıştır.

Sergi, izleyicinin kendi bilinmeyenlerine ayna tutarak sorgulamalarına ve içsel yolculuklarını
 keşfetmelerine olanak tanıyacak. İrfan Önürmen’nin “Bilinmeyen Neden” başlıklı sergisi sanatseverleri
 bekliyor.

C24 GALLERY Hakkında:
 C24 Gallery, 2011 yılında Chelsea, New York’ta kurulmuştur ve köklü sanatçıların sergilendiği çoğul bir
 programa vurgu yaparak çağdaş sanatı sergilemeye kendini adamıştır. C24 Gallery sanatçıları düzenli
 olarak müze sergilerine ve bienallere katılmakta ve dünya çapında önde gelen kurumsal koleksiyonlarda
 yer almaktadır.
 Ünlü küratörlerin işbirliğini içeren iddialı bir sergi programına ek olarak C24 Gallery, düzenli olarak sanatçı
 konuşmalarına ve konferanslara ev sahipliği yapmakta, aynı zamanda katalog ve sanatçı kitapları
 üretmektedir. Her yıl, dünyanın dört bir yanındaki önemli sanat fuarlarına katılmaktadır.

C24 GALLERY
 560 W 24th Street
 New York, NY 10011 USA
events.description_en:
İrfan Önürmen’s exhibition "Unknown Reason" displays different techniques and approaches, from
 tulle works, which are the artist’s unique style, to paper collages, concrete works to canvases. In
 addition to these familiar techniques, the artist adds a new material to his rich repertoire, presenting
 his works created by painting and rubbing on sandpaper. The artist is interested in the material,
 which in turn nourishes him. He does not hesitate to experiment to open up new areas for himself
 through his productive adventure and in this sense, he turns his adventure into a game. These
 bifurcations he experiences and his desire to walk different paths also mean the enrichment of his
 formal language. The artist never broke his connection with the canvas and kept coming back to
 canvas painting. The transparency, three-dimensionality and depth effects created by İrfan
 Önürmen in his tulle works can also be viewed in his paintings. The figure never disappears in the
 works of the artist, who has developed an imagery that sometimes strays from the boundaries of
 abstract painting. The human being becomes blurred, fragmented and uncertain, but always reveals
 themselves as a great problematic in the middle of his painting. Here, human is a political image, not
 a slogan.
 His exhibition “Unknown Reason” is about the accumulation and remnants of the artist’s own past
 with which he wants to create a philosophical field of inquiry. The artist thinks and produces about
 the uncertainties shaped by this existential field and the meanings that cannot be resolved or fully
 grasped. The exhibition’s structure and the works are based on the unknown and the ambiguity of
 meaning. In all of his works, which vary in terms of form, language and representational content, the
 artist cares about the impact he creates on the viewer beyond formal references. Gradually, he
 encourages the audience to realize their inner journey by directing them towards their own
 unknowns and questions. No matter what concept or material Önürmen works with, the reality and
 imagination in his world blur all formal categories with the visible and the invisible. In his exhibition,
 he experiments with the creation of new paths by juxtaposing his old and new works without any
 chronological order. In this exhibition, he wants to emphasize the relationships between his different
 approaches and productions, to reveal the problems of form and content, and to discuss them within
 himself.

The exhibition will allow the audience to question their own unknowns by holding a mirror up to
 them and explore their inner journeys. İrfan Önürmen’s exhibition titled "Unknown Reason" awaits
 art lovers.

About C24 GALLERY:
 C24 Gallery was established in 2011 in Chelsea, New York, and is committed to showcasing
 contemporary art with an emphasis on a plural program exhibiting established artists. C24 Gallery
 artists regularly participate in museum exhibitions and biennials and are included in leading
 institutional collections worldwide.

In addition to an ambitious exhibition program, which includes collaborations with renowned
 curators, C24 Gallery regularly hosts artist talks and lectures, and produces catalogues and artist
 books. Each year the gallery participates in major art fairs all around the world.
events.description_el:
Η προσωπική έκθεση του καλλιτέχνη İrfan Önürmen με τίτλο "Unknown Reason" που διοργάνωσε η C24 Gallery, 3 Νοεμβρίου
 – Συναντάται με λάτρεις της τέχνης στο Ελληνικό Σχολείο Γαλατά μεταξύ 2 Δεκεμβρίου 2024.

Στην έκθεση του İrfan Önürmen με τίτλο "Unknown Reason", ένα από τα τούλια έργα του καλλιτέχνη, που είναι το πρωτότυπο στυλ του,
 Μπορούμε να δούμε διαφορετικές τεχνικές και προσεγγίσεις, από κολάζ από χαρτί μέχρι έργα από σκυρόδεμα μέχρι καμβάδες. Αυτό είναι γνωστό
 Εκτός από τις τεχνικές του, ο καλλιτέχνης πρόσθεσε ένα νέο υλικό στο πλούσιο ρεπερτόριό του, ζωγραφίζοντας σε γυαλόχαρτο.
 Παρουσιάζει τα έργα του που δημιουργήθηκαν με μπογιά και τρίψιμο. Ο καλλιτέχνης ενδιαφέρεται για το υλικό και αυτό το ενδιαφέρον τον τρέφει. Παραγωγή
 Δεν διστάζει να πειραματιστεί για να ανοίξει νέες περιοχές για τον εαυτό του στην περιπέτειά του και με αυτή την έννοια
 Παίξτε την περιπέτειά σας. Αυτές οι διακλαδώσεις που βιώνει και η επιθυμία του να περπατήσει σε διαφορετικά μονοπάτια, από την άλλη,
 Σημαίνει τον εμπλουτισμό της γλώσσας της μορφής. Ο καλλιτέχνης δεν έσπασε ποτέ τους δεσμούς του με τη ζωγραφική σε καμβά και επέστρεψε στο
 Το μέρος ήταν πάντα ένας πίνακας ζωγραφικής. Η διαφάνεια, η τρισδιάσταση και το στυλ που δημιούργησε ο İrfan Önürmen στα έργα του από τούλι.
 Τα εφέ βάθους φαίνονται επίσης στη βαφή. Ένα εικονογραφικό που περιφέρεται ενίοτε στα όρια της αφηρημένης ζωγραφικής.
 Η φιγούρα δεν χάνεται ποτέ στα έργα του καλλιτέχνη που αναπτύσσει τη γλώσσα. Τα ανθρώπινα όντα γίνονται θολά, κατακερματισμένα και αβέβαια.
 αλλά πάντα αποκαλύπτεται σαν μεγάλο πρόβλημα στη μέση του πίνακα. Εδώ ο κόσμος δεν φωνάζει συνθήματα.
 αλλά είναι μια πολιτική εικόνα.

Η έκθεση "Unknown Reason" έχει να κάνει με τη συσσώρευση και τα απομεινάρια του παρελθόντος του ίδιου του καλλιτέχνη. και με αυτό
 Ήθελε να δημιουργήσει ένα πεδίο φιλοσοφικής έρευνας. Ο καλλιτέχνης βιώνει τις αβεβαιότητες που διαμορφώνει αυτό το υπαρξιακό πεδίο,
 σκέφτεται και παράγει νοήματα που δεν μπορούν να αποκρυπτογραφηθούν ή να κατανοηθούν πλήρως. Το στήσιμο της έκθεσης
 και στήριξε τις παραγωγές του στην αφάνεια και την ασάφεια του νοήματος. Μορφή καλλιτέχνη, γλώσσα και αναπαράσταση
 Σε όλα του τα έργα, τα οποία ποικίλλουν ως προς το περιεχόμενο, δημιουργεί αντίκτυπο στο κοινό πέρα από τυπικές αναφορές.
 νοιάζεται για τον αντίκτυπο. Εξερευνά σταδιακά το εσωτερικό του ταξίδι κατευθύνοντας το κοινό στα δικά του άγνωστα και ερωτήματα.
 ενθαρρύνει την ευαισθητοποίηση. Ανεξάρτητα από την ιδέα ή το υλικό με το οποίο συνεργάζεται η Önürmen,
 η πραγματικότητα και η φαντασία θολώνουν όλες τις επίσημες κατηγορίες με το ορατό και το αόρατο. Στην έκθεση
 Δημιουργεί νέα μονοπάτια κατασκευάζοντας τα παλιά και τα νέα του έργα δίπλα-δίπλα και διαδοχικά, χωρίς χρονολογική σειρά.
 Βιώνουν και τον σχηματισμό του. Σε αυτή την έκθεση, για να τονίσουμε τις σχέσεις μεταξύ των διαφορετικών προσεγγίσεων και παραγωγών τους,
 Ήθελε να αποκαλύψει τυπικά προβλήματα και προβλήματα που σχετίζονται με το περιεχόμενο και στόχευε να τα συζητήσει μέσα του.

Η έκθεση επιτρέπει στο κοινό να αμφισβητήσει τα δικά του άγνωστα και να εξερευνήσει τα εσωτερικά του ταξίδια.
 θα τους επιτρέψει να εξερευνήσουν. Η έκθεση του İrfan Önürmen με τίτλο "Unknown Reason" θα ενθουσιάσει τους λάτρεις της τέχνης
 αναμονή.

Σχετικά με το C24 GALLERY:
 Η C24 Gallery ιδρύθηκε το 2011 στο Chelsea της Νέας Υόρκης και είναι μια πληθώρα γκαλερί που παρουσιάζει καταξιωμένους καλλιτέχνες.
 δεσμεύεται να προβάλλει τη σύγχρονη τέχνη με έμφαση στον προγραμματισμό. Καλλιτέχνες της Γκαλερί C24 τακτικά

events.title_tr: Ceren Oykut’un "Konstantiniye ve Ayasofya Defterleri" adlı sergisi.
events.title_en: Exhibition by Ceren Oykut: "Sketchbooks of Constantinople and Hagia Sophia.
events.title_el: Έκθεση της Ceren Oykut: "Τα Σημειωματάρια της Κωνσταντινούπολης και της Αγίας Σοφίας".
events.description_tr:
Ceren Oykut'un "Konstantinopolis ve Ayasofya Eskiz Defterleri" sergisi, Stefanos Yerasimos'un 1990 yılında yazdığı "La Fondation de Constantinople et de Sainte-Sophie Dans les Traditions Turques" (Türk Geleneklerinde Konstantinopolis ve Ayasofya'nın Vakfı) adlı kitaptan ilham alınarak hazırlandı.

Günlük hayattan edindiği detaylarla geniş peyzaj çizimleri yapan Oykut, karikatür, minyatür ve haritacılık unsurlarından yararlanıyor. Bu sergide Oykut, Yerosimos'un kitaptaki efsanelerin yaratım ve dönüşüm süreçlerini incelerken formüle ettiği yöntemleri, çizimlerindeki “öğeleri” kullanarak keserek, kırparak, sürükleyerek ve çoğaltarak kendi yerel bağlamlarından kopararak yeni topoğrafyalar yaratmayı amaçlıyor.

Oykut, kitapta Ayasofya'nın inşası sırasında geçen bir efsaneye de değiniyor. Henüz adı konmamış katedral efsanesinde hem koruyucu, hem melek, hem çırak hem de kurban olarak görülen bir karakter aracılığıyla Oykut, günümüz İstanbul'una bağlanıyor. Zamanı ve mekanı yaşayan bir haritaya dönüştürmek için devam eden çalışmalarını ve süreçlerini bir arada sergiliyor.
events.description_en:
Ceren Oykut’s exhibition “Sketchbooks of Constantinople and Hagia Sophia” was prepared with inspiration from the book named ” La Fondation de Constantinople et de Sainte-Sophie Dans les Traditions Turques” (The Foundation of Constantinople and Hagia Sophia in turkish Traditions) written by Stefanos Yerasimos in 1990.

Making broad landscape drawings built on details acquired from everyday life, Oykut utilizes elements from caricature, miniature and cartography. In this exhibition, Oykut intends to apply the methods that Yerosimos formulated while studying the creation and transformation processes of legends within the book, using “items” from her drawings with detaching them from their native context by cutting, cropping, dragging and multiplying to create new topographies.

Oykut also concentrates on a legend told in the book that takes place during construction of Hagia Sophia. Through a character which can be seen as a guardian, an angel, an apprentice and a victim at the same time in the legend of yet unnamed cathedral, Oykut links to contemporary Istanbul. She exhibits her works in progress and their process together to turn time and space into a living cartography.
events.description_el:
Η έκθεση της Ceren Oykut «Sketchbooks of Constantinople and Hagia Sophia» ετοιμάστηκε με έμπνευση από το βιβλίο με το όνομα «La Fondation de Constantinople et de Sainte-Sophie Dans les Traditions Turques» (Το Ίδρυμα της Κωνσταντινούπολης και της Αγίας Σοφίας στις τουρκικές παραδόσεις) που έγραψε ο Στέφανος 991.

Κάνοντας πλατιά σχέδια τοπίων βασισμένα σε λεπτομέρειες που αποκτήθηκαν από την καθημερινή ζωή, το Oykut χρησιμοποιεί στοιχεία από καρικατούρες, μινιατούρες και χαρτογραφία. Σε αυτήν την έκθεση, η Oykut σκοπεύει να εφαρμόσει τις μεθόδους που διατύπωσε ο Γερόσιμος μελετώντας τις διαδικασίες δημιουργίας και μετασχηματισμού των θρύλων μέσα στο βιβλίο, χρησιμοποιώντας «αντικείμενα» από τα σχέδιά της αποσπώντας τα από το εγγενές περιβάλλον τους κόβοντας, περικόπτοντας, σύροντας και πολλαπλασιάζοντας για να δημιουργήσει νέες τοπογραφίες.

Ο Oykut επικεντρώνεται επίσης σε έναν θρύλο που λέγεται στο βιβλίο που διαδραματίζεται κατά την κατασκευή της Αγίας Σοφίας. Μέσω ενός χαρακτήρα που μπορεί να θεωρηθεί ως φύλακας, άγγελος, μαθητευόμενος και θύμα ταυτόχρονα στον θρύλο του ακόμη ανώνυμου καθεδρικού ναού, ο Oykut συνδέεται με τη σύγχρονη Κωνσταντινούπολη. Εκθέτει τα έργα της σε εξέλιξη και τη διαδικασία τους μαζί για να μετατρέψουν τον χρόνο και τον χώρο σε ζωντανή χαρτογραφία.

events.title_en: Greek Islanders in the Ottoman Era
events.title_el: Έλληνες Νησιώτες κατά την Οθωμανική Περίοδο
events.description_tr:
Osmanlı Döneminde Adalı Rumlar — Kitap Tanıtımı ve Söyleşi

Konuşmacı: Dr. Feryal Tansuğ
Tarih: 18 Nisan 2018, Saat 18:00
Yer: Galata Rum Okulu

Dr. Feryal Tansuğ’un katılımıyla Galata Rum Okulu’nda düzenlenen bu söyleşi ve kitap tanıtımı etkinliğinde, Osmanlı döneminde Ege ve İstanbul adalarında yaşayan Rum topluluklarının sosyal, ekonomik ve kültürel tarihi ele alındı. Konuşma dili Türkçedir.
events.description_en:
Greek Islanders in the Ottoman Era — Book Launch and Talk

Speaker: Dr. Feryal Tansuğ
Date: April 18, 2018, 18:00
Venue: Galata Greek School

Featuring historian Dr. Feryal Tansuğ, this book launch and lecture at the Galata Greek School examined the social, economic, and cultural history of Greek islander communities during the Ottoman era. The talk was conducted in Turkish.
events.description_el:
Έλληνες Νησιώτες κατά την Οθωμανική Περίοδο — Παρουσίαση Βιβλίου και Διάλεξη

Ομιλήτρια: Δρ. Feryal Tansuğ
Ημερομηνία: 18 Απριλίου 2018, 18:00
Χώρος: Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά

Με τη συμμετοχή της ιστορικού Δρ. Feryal Tansuğ, η εκδήλωση παρουσίασης βιβλίου και ομιλίας στην Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά εξέτασε την κοινωνική, οικονομική και πολιτιστική ιστορία των ελληνικών νησιωτικών κοινοτήτων κατά την οθωμανική περίοδο.

events.title_el: Σχετικά με την Έκθεση "Φθίνων Χρόνος" του Çağrı Saray
events.description_tr:
30 Nisan 2015’e kadar devam edecek olan Çağrı Saray’ın “Eksilen Zaman” adlı sergisinin içeriğinin ve hazırlık-üretim sürecinin tartışılacağı söyleşi, 19 Nisan 2015 Pazar günü saat 16.00’da Galata Özel Rum İlkokulu’nda.

ESRA ALİÇAVUŞOĞLU (1973/İstanbul), 1996’da İstanbul Üniversitesi Edebiyat Fakültesi Sanat Tarihi Bölümü’nden mezun oldu. Aynı kurumda, 1999’da yüksek lisansını; 2005’te ise “1980 Sonrası Türk Sanatı’nda Sanatçının Yaratımında Kendilik Temsili” başlıklı tezi ile doktorasını tamamladı. 1996-2002 yılları arasında; Cumhuriyet gazetesi’nde kültür-sanat muhabirliği, Yapı Kredi Yayınları tarafından çıkarılan Sanat Dünyamız dergisinde editörlük, Tarih Vakfı İstanbul dergisinde Genel Yayın Yönetmeni olarak çalıştı. Halen sanat tarihi derslerini verdiği Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi’nde öğretim üyesi olarak görev yapmaktadır. AICA Uluslararası Sanat Eleştirmenleri Derneği üyesidir, 2006-2010 yılları arasında Cumhuriyet gazetesinde, halen ise tasarım kültürü dergisi Arredamento Mimarlık’ta ve süreli diğer yayınlarda aylık sanat eleştirileri ve yazıları yazmaktadır.

ÇAĞRI SARAY (1979/İstanbul) 2001’de Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi Resim Bölümü’nden mezun oldu. 2002-2004 yılları arasında Bahçeşehir Üniversitesi İletişim Fakültesi Görsel Sanatlar ve Görsel İletişim Tasarımı Bölümü’nde araştırma görevlisi olarak görev yaptı. 2004 yılında Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi’nde Yükseklisans, 2007 yılında Sanatta Yeterlik programlarından mezun oldu. 2007’de Marmara Üniversitesi Güzel Sanatlar Fakültesi Temel Eğitim Bölümü’nde Araştırma Görevlisi olarak çalışmaya başladı. Halen aynı kurumda Yardımcı Doçent olarak görevine devam etmektedir.
 2001’den bu yana “Gri Koridor” (2013, Paris, Fransa), “4/12: Bir Ev’in Topoğrafyası” (2011, İstanbul, Türkiye) ve “Bellek Kutuları-1” (2001, İstanbul, Türkiye) sergileri dahil olmak üzere 9 kişisel sergi gerçekleştirmiştir. “Kopuşlar ve Kavuşmalar” (2014, Kuad Galeri, İstanbul), “3.Uluslararası Çanakkale Bienali” (2012, Çanakkale, Türkiye) ve “Ateşin Düştüğü Yer” (2011, İstanbul, Türkiye) dahil olmak üzere 80’in üzerinde yurtiçi ve yurtdışı karma ve grup sergilerinde işleri sergilenmiştir.
events.description_en:
The conversation, which will discuss the content and preparation-production process of Çağrı Saray's exhibition "Less Time", which will continue until April 30, 2015, will be held on Sunday, April 19, 2015 at 16.00 at Galata Private Greek Primary School.

ESRA ALİÇAVUŞOĞLU (1973/Istanbul) graduated from Istanbul University, Faculty of Letters, Department of Art History in 1996. He completed his master's degree at the same institution in 1999; In 2005, he completed his doctorate with his thesis titled "Representation of Self in the Artist's Creation in Post-1980 Turkish Art". Between 1996-2002; He worked as a culture and arts correspondent in Cumhuriyet newspaper, as an editor in Sanat Dünyamuz magazine published by Yapı Kredi Publications, and as Editor-in-Chief in History Foundation Istanbul magazine. He currently works as a lecturer at Marmara University Faculty of Fine Arts, where he teaches art history. He is a member of AICA International Association of Art Critics. He wrote monthly art criticisms and articles in Cumhuriyet newspaper between 2006 and 2010, and currently in the design culture magazine Arredamento Mimarlık and other periodicals.

ÇAĞRI SARAY (1979/Istanbul) graduated from Marmara University, Faculty of Fine Arts, Department of Painting in 2001. Between 2002 and 2004, he worked as a research assistant at Bahçeşehir University, Faculty of Communication, Department of Visual Arts and Visual Communication Design. He graduated from Marmara University Faculty of Fine Arts with a master's degree in 2004 and from the Proficiency in Art program in 2007. In 2007, he started working as a Research Assistant at Marmara University, Faculty of Fine Arts, Department of Basic Education. He currently continues to work as an Assistant Professor at the same institution.
 Since 2001, he has held 9 personal exhibitions, including "Grey Corridor" (2013, Paris, France), "4/12: Topography of a House" (2011, Istanbul, Turkey) and "Memory Boxes-1" (2001, Istanbul, Turkey). His works have been exhibited in more than 80 domestic and international group and group exhibitions, including “Breaks and Reunions” (2014, Kuad Gallery, Istanbul), “3rd International Çanakkale Biennial” (2012, Çanakkale, Turkey) and “Where the Fire Falls” (2011, Istanbul, Turkey).
events.description_el:
Η συζήτηση, που θα συζητήσει το περιεχόμενο και τη διαδικασία προετοιμασίας-παραγωγής της έκθεσης του Çağrı Saray «Λιγότερος Χρόνος», που θα συνεχιστεί έως τις 30 Απριλίου 2015, θα πραγματοποιηθεί την Κυριακή 19 Απριλίου 2015 στις 16.00 στο Ιδιωτικό Ελληνικό Δημοτικό Σχολείο Γαλατά.

Ο ESRA ALİÇAVUŞOĞLU (1973/Κωνσταντινούπολη) αποφοίτησε από το Πανεπιστήμιο της Κωνσταντινούπολης, Σχολή Γραμμάτων, Τμήμα Ιστορίας της Τέχνης το 1996. Ολοκλήρωσε το μεταπτυχιακό του στο ίδιο ίδρυμα το 1999. Το 2005 ολοκλήρωσε το διδακτορικό του με τη διατριβή του με τίτλο «Αναπαράσταση του εαυτού στη δημιουργία του καλλιτέχνη στην τουρκική τέχνη μετά το 1980». Μεταξύ 1996-2002; Εργάστηκε ως ανταποκριτής πολιτισμού και τεχνών στην εφημερίδα Cumhuriyet, ως συντάκτης στο περιοδικό Sanat Dünyamuz που εκδίδεται από τις Εκδόσεις Yapı Kredi και ως Αρχισυντάκτης στο περιοδικό History Foundation Istanbul. Σήμερα εργάζεται ως λέκτορας στη Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών του Πανεπιστημίου του Μαρμαρά, όπου διδάσκει ιστορία της τέχνης. Είναι μέλος της Διεθνούς Ένωσης Κριτικών Τέχνης AICA. Έγραφε μηνιαίες κριτικές τέχνης και άρθρα στην εφημερίδα Cumhuriyet μεταξύ 2006 και 2010, και επί του παρόντος στο περιοδικό σχεδιαστικής κουλτούρας Arredamento Mimarlık και σε άλλα περιοδικά.

Ο ÇAĞRI SARAY (1979/Κωνσταντινούπολη) αποφοίτησε από το Πανεπιστήμιο του Μαρμαρά, Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών, Τμήμα Ζωγραφικής το 2001. Μεταξύ 2002 και 2004, εργάστηκε ως βοηθός ερευνητής στο Πανεπιστήμιο Bahçeşehir, Σχολή Επικοινωνίας, Τμήμα Εικαστικών Τεχνών και Εικαστικών Τεχνών. Αποφοίτησε από τη Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών του Πανεπιστημίου του Μαρμαρά με μεταπτυχιακό το 2004 και από το πρόγραμμα Proficiency in Art το 2007. Το 2007 άρχισε να εργάζεται ως βοηθός ερευνητής στο Πανεπιστήμιο του Μαρμαρά, Σχολή Καλών Τεχνών, Τμήμα Βασικής Εκπαίδευσης. Σήμερα συνεχίζει να εργάζεται ως Επίκουρος Καθηγητής στο ίδιο ίδρυμα.
 Από το 2001 έχει πραγματοποιήσει 9 ατομικές εκθέσεις, μεταξύ των οποίων «Grey Corridor» (2013, Παρίσι, Γαλλία), «4/12: Topography of a House» (2011, Istanbul, Turkey) και «Memory Boxes-1» (2001, Istanbul, Turkey). Τα έργα του έχουν εκτεθεί σε περισσότερες από 80 εγχώριες και διεθνείς ομαδικές και ομαδικές εκθέσεις, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των «Breaks and Reunions» (2014, Kuad Gallery, Istanbul), «3rd International Çanakkale Biennial» (2012, Çanakkale, Τουρκία) και «Where the Fire Falls» (2011, Istanbul, Turkey).

events.description_tr:
Galata Rum Okulu’nun Açık Okul Kütüphanesi’nde yer alan Erinç Seymen‘in sergisi  ”En Başa Dön” kapsamında yer alacak okuma serileri Rita Ender yönetiminde gerçekleşecek. Ender’in kaybolmaya yüz tutmuş meslek ve zanaatlerin son ustaları ile yaptığı söyleşilerinin derlendiği ”Kolay Gelsin: Meslekler ve Mekanlar” kitabında yer verdiği meslek sahiplerinden Artin Aharon ve Hraç Arslanyan okuma serilerinin konukları olacaklar.

4 Mayıs 2017 Perşembe: Rita Ender ve Artin Aharon
 11 Mayıs 2017 Perşembe: Rita Ender ve Hraç Arslanyan
 Saat 18.00-19.00

Konuşma dili Türkçedir.

Galata Rum Okulu, bir proje ve okuma odası olarak yürüttüğü ve okulun 4.katındaki Açık Okul Kütüphanesin’de yer alan Erinç Seymen‘in “En Başa Dön” başlıklı sergisi azınlık kimliklerine atfedilen zanaatlerin ve mesleki  ustalıkların, hem yaşam kalım gereci olarak işlevselliğini hem de toplumları şematize eden göstergelere dönüşümünü tartışmaya açmayı hedefliyor. Resim ve heykelden oluşan yerleştirme izleyiciyi,  kimi zaman bireylerin ünvanları olarak ortaya çıkan, kimi zaman ise soyadlarına dönüşen mesleki becerilerin olumlayıcı vurgusunun yanında, toplumların imgeleri üzerindeki nostaljik ve tektipleştirici etkisini düşünmeye davet ediyor. Sergi, aileden devralınan ve nesilden nesile iletilen zanaatlerin iki boyutlu ve romantik bir tipler tiyatrosu içinde resmedilmesi riskine karşılık meslek/emek türü ile kültürel kimlik ilişkisini indirgemeci bakıştan kurtarmanın gerekliliğini işaret ediyor.
events.description_en:
The reading series, which will take place within the scope of Erinç Seymen's exhibition  "Back to the Beginning" at the Open School Library of Galata Greek School, will be held under the direction of Rita Ender. Artin Aharon and Hraç Arslanyan, two of the professionals included in Ender's book "Kolay Gelsin: Professions and Places", which compiles his interviews with the last masters of professions and crafts that are about to disappear, will be the guests of the reading series.

Thursday, May 4, 2017: Rita Ender and Artin Aharon
 Thursday, May 11, 2017: Rita Ender and Hrac Arslanyan
 Time 18.00-19.00

The spoken language is Turkish.

Erinç Seymen's exhibition titled "Back to the Beginning", which is carried out as a project and reading room at Galata Greek School and is located in the Open School Library on the 4th floor of the school, aims to discuss both the functionality of crafts and professional masteries attributed to minority identities as survival tools and their transformation into indicators that schematize societies. The installation, consisting of paintings and sculptures, invites the viewer to consider the affirmative emphasis of professional skills, which sometimes appear as titles of individuals and sometimes turn into surnames, as well as their nostalgic and standardizing effect on the images of societies. The exhibition points out the necessity of saving the relationship between profession/labour type and cultural identity from a reductionist view, in response to the risk of portraying the crafts inherited from the family and transmitted from generation to generation within a two-dimensional and romantic theater of types.
events.description_el:
Η σειρά ανάγνωσης, που θα πραγματοποιηθεί στο πλαίσιο της έκθεσης του Erinç Seymen  «Back to the Beginning» στην Open School Library του Ελληνικού Σχολείου Γαλατά, θα πραγματοποιηθεί υπό τη διεύθυνση της Rita Ender. Οι Artin Aharon και Hraç Arslanyan, δύο από τους επαγγελματίες που περιλαμβάνονται στο βιβλίο του Ender "Kolay Gelsin: Professions and Places", το οποίο συγκεντρώνει τις συνεντεύξεις του με τους τελευταίους μάστορες επαγγελμάτων και χειροτεχνιών που πρόκειται να εξαφανιστούν, θα είναι οι καλεσμένοι της σειράς ανάγνωσης.

Πέμπτη 4 Μαΐου 2017: Rita Ender και Artin Aharon
 Πέμπτη 11 Μαΐου 2017: Rita Ender και Hrac Arslanyan
 Ώρα 18.00-19.00

Η ομιλούμενη γλώσσα είναι η τουρκική.

Η έκθεση του Erinç Seymen με τίτλο "Back to the Beginning", η οποία πραγματοποιείται ως έργο και αναγνωστήριο στο Ελληνικό Σχολείο Γαλατά και βρίσκεται στην Open School Library στον 4ο όροφο του σχολείου, στοχεύει να συζητήσει τόσο τη λειτουργικότητα των χειροτεχνιών όσο και τις επαγγελματικές δεξιότητες που αποδίδονται στις μειονοτικές ταυτότητες ως εργαλεία επιβίωσης και τη μετατροπή τους σε δείκτες που σχηματοποιούν την κοινωνία. Η εγκατάσταση, που αποτελείται από πίνακες και γλυπτά, καλεί τον θεατή να αναλογιστεί την καταφατική έμφαση των επαγγελματικών δεξιοτήτων, που άλλοτε εμφανίζονται ως τίτλοι ατόμων και άλλοτε μετατρέπονται σε επώνυμα, καθώς και τη νοσταλγική και τυποποιητική τους επίδραση στις εικόνες των κοινωνιών. Η έκθεση επισημαίνει την ανάγκη να διασωθεί η σχέση μεταξύ επαγγέλματος/εργατικού τύπου και πολιτισμικής ταυτότητας από μια αναγωγική άποψη, ως απάντηση στον κίνδυνο απεικόνισης των χειροτεχνιών που κληρονομήθηκαν από την οικογένεια και μεταδίδονται από γενιά σε γενιά σε ένα δισδιάστατο και ρομαντικό θέατρο τύπων.

events.description_tr:
Zoğrafyon Lisesi’nin düzenlediği 8. Uluslararası Yannis Ritsos Edebiyatı Konferansları kapsamında konuşmacıları ve öğrencileri okulumuzda misafir ettik!

Yunan edebiyatının önde gelen şairlerinden ve yazarlarından biri olan Yannis Ritsos’un eserleri ve edebi mirası üzerine derinlemesine bir inceleme gerçekleştirdik. Konferansta bizimle olan değerli konuşmacılarımızla, Ritsos’un sanatını, etkisini ve edebiyata olan katkılarını tartıştık. Ayrıca Yunanistan’dan gelen öğrencilerle kültürlerarası bir etkileşimde bulunduk, edebiyatın evrensel dilini paylaştık.
events.description_en:
As part of the 8th International Yannis Ritsos Literature Conferences organized by Zografyon High School, we proudly welcomed distinguished speakers and students to the Galata Greek School.

Together we explored in depth the works and literary legacy of Yannis Ritsos, one of the foremost poets and authors of modern Greek literature. With our guest speakers and visiting students from Greece, we discussed Ritsos's art, enduring influence, and contributions to world literature in a spirit of intercultural dialogue.
events.description_el:
Στο πλαίσιο του 8ου Διεθνούς Συνεδρίου Λογοτεχνίας «Γιάννης Ρίτσος» που διοργάνωσε το Ζωγράφειο Λύκειο, είχαμε τη χαρά να φιλοξενήσουμε τους ομιλητές και τους μαθητές στην Ελληνική Σχολή Γαλατά.

Πραγματοποιήσαμε μια εις βάθος προσέγγιση στο έργο και την πνευματική παρακαταθήκη του Γιάννη Ρίτσου, ενός από τους κορυφαίους ποιητές της νεοελληνικής λογοτεχνίας, συζητώντας με διακεκριμένους εισηγητές και μαθητές από την Ελλάδα για την τέχνη, την επιρροή και την παγκόσμια απήχηση της ποίησής του.

events.title_el: Το Αρχείο του Ελληνικού Σχολείου Γαλατά Αναζητά τους Αποφοίτους του
events.description_tr:
Galata Rum Okulu, 2013 yılından bu yana<< AÇIK OKUL>> adı altında arşiv çalışmalarını yürütmektedir.
 Hollanda Başkonsolosluğunun<< MATRA>> fonu ile desteklenen çalışmalar doğrultusunda okul arşivi düzenlenerek, var olan öğrenci kayıtları gün yüzüne çıkartılmıştır.

23 Mart 2017 tarihinde beşincisi düzenlenecek olan Geleneksel Mezunlar Buluşması çerçevesinde, Galata Rum Okulu, mezunlarına ulaşarak, okul arşivinde var olan öğrenci kayıtları ile onları buluşturmayı hedefliyor.

Kayıtlarına ulaşmak isteyen mezunların Galata Rum Okulu ekibi ile galatarum@gmail.com adresine İsim, Soyad ve mezun oldukları yılı yazarak iletişime geçmeleri rica olunur.

Saygılarımızla,
 Galata Rum Okulu Ekibi
events.description_en:
Galata Greek School has been carrying out archive studies under the name << OPEN SCHOOL>> since 2013.
 In line with the studies supported by the Dutch Consulate General<< MATRA>> fund, the school archive was organized and existing student records were brought to light.

Within the framework of the 5th Traditional Alumni Meeting, which will be held on March 23, 2017, Galata Greek School aims to reach its graduates and bring them together with the student records in the school archive.

Graduates who want to access their records are requested to contact the Galata Greek School team by writing their name, surname and the year they graduated to galatarum@gmail.com.

Best regards,
 Galata Greek School Team
events.description_el:
Το Ελληνικό Σχολείο Γαλατά πραγματοποιεί αρχειακές μελέτες με την επωνυμία << ΑΝΟΙΧΤΟ ΣΧΟΛΕΙΟ>> από το 2013.
 Σύμφωνα με τις μελέτες που υποστηρίζονται από το ταμείο του Γενικού Προξενείου της Ολλανδίας<< MATRA>>, οργανώθηκε το αρχείο του σχολείου και ήρθαν στο φως τα υπάρχοντα αρχεία μαθητών.

Στο πλαίσιο της 5ης Παραδοσιακής Συνάντησης Αποφοίτων, που θα πραγματοποιηθεί στις 23 Μαρτίου 2017, το Ελληνικό Σχολείο Γαλατά στοχεύει να προσεγγίσει τους αποφοίτους του και να τους φέρει μαζί με τα αρχεία των μαθητών στο αρχείο του σχολείου.

Οι απόφοιτοι που θέλουν να αποκτήσουν πρόσβαση στα αρχεία τους παρακαλούνται να επικοινωνήσουν με την ομάδα του Ελληνικού Σχολείου Γαλατά γράφοντας το όνομα, το επίθετό τους και το έτος που αποφοίτησαν στο galatarum@gmail.com.

Με εκτίμηση,
 Ομάδα Ελληνικού Σχολείου Γαλατά

events.description_tr:
Görsel: Hera Büyüktaşcıyan & Galata Rum Okulu

Galata Rum Okulu’nun Açık Okul Kütüphanesinde yer alan Reysi Kamhi’nin sergisi ”Düşünce Bahçesi” kapsamında yer alacak okuma serilerinin üçüncüsü Camila Rocha yönetiminde 14 Haziran Salı saat 18.00-19.00 arasında gerçekleşecek.

”Çocuklar çiçeklerin en güzelidir”, Camila Rocha okumasında, Oscar Wilde’ın ” Bencil Dev” isimli hikayesini, kendi hayali mekanlarına dair gerçekleştireceği sunum eşliğinde okuyacak.

Okuma ve konuşma İngilizce gerçekleşecektir.
events.description_en:
Image: Hera Büyüktaşcıyan & Galata Greek School

This third edition of the reading sessions realized within the scope of Galata Greek School’s “Open School Project” in the framework of Reysi Kamhi’s show
 ”A Garden of Thoughts”, will be conducted by Camila Rocha on 14th June Tuesday, between 6 – 7 pm.

“The children are the most beautiful flower of all…”, Camila Rocha will be reading “The Selfish Giant” by Oscar Wilde accompanied by a presentation of her imagined environments.

The reading and the talk will be in English.
events.description_el:
Εικόνα: Hera Büyüktaşcıyan & Ελληνικό Σχολείο Γαλατά

Η τρίτη της σειράς ανάγνωσης, που θα πραγματοποιηθεί στο πλαίσιο της έκθεσης της Ρέυση Καμχή «Κήπος της Σκέψης» που βρίσκεται στην Ανοιχτή Σχολική Βιβλιοθήκη του Ελληνικού Σχολείου Γαλατά, θα πραγματοποιηθεί υπό τη διεύθυνση της Καμίλα Ρότσα, την Τρίτη 14 Ιουνίου, μεταξύ 18.00-19.00.

Στην ανάγνωσή της «Τα παιδιά είναι τα πιο όμορφα λουλούδια», η Camila Rocha θα διαβάσει την ιστορία του Oscar Wilde «The Selfish Giant» συνοδευόμενη από μια παρουσίαση για τα δικά της φανταστικά μέρη.

Η ανάγνωση και η ομιλία θα γίνονται στα αγγλικά.

Εκλεκτοί μας φίλοι και ομογάλακτοι αδελφοί μας,

Με πολλή χαρά σας προσκαλούμε να τιμήσετε με την παρουσία σας την ετήσια συνάντη-ση των αποφοίτων της Σχολής Γαλατά, η οποία θα πραγματοποιηθεί στις 23 Μαρτίου 2017 και ώρα 17.30, στην αγαπημένη μας Σχολή. Η εκδήλωσή μας θα συνεχιστεί με το μουσικό πρόγραμμα της καλλιτεχνικής ομάδας του κυρίου Μάνου Κουτσογγελίδη. Ελάτε όλοι στη Σχολή Γαλατά για μια ευχάριστη χαρούμενη βραδιά.

Την εκδηλωση θα ευλογήσει με την υψηλή παρουσία Του η Α.Θ.Π ο Οικουμενικός Πατριάρχης κ. κ.Βαρθολομαίος.
